name: @formsdk/sdk

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir=dist --format=esm --target=node --external react --external react-dom --external enquirer --external @supabase/supabase-js --external @neondatabase/serverless --external ws --external @libsql/client --external @prisma/client --external drizzle-orm --external postgres --external better-auth --external node:module --external node:fs --external node:fs/promises --external node:os --external node:crypto --external node:net --external node:tls --external node:perf_hooks --external node:path --external node:url --external postgres && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.pub: bun run build && npm publish --access public
